caption:
Sydney 2026 runners-up Amakazaam! from Amazon take on Queen and David Bowie's Under Pressure at the Manning Bar. This stunning vocal performance had the crowd snapping and clapping along, and won them judges' choice of the night.

Video shot by @sailornicole and @demonrace. Photos and video sponsored by V2 AI.

Proudly powered by Jumbo Interactive. All proceeds to @youngcareoz, supporting young Australians with high care needs to live with more choice, freedom and dignity.
